name: Coucou
description: Connects to salon booking systems (Planity, Treatwell, Booksy, Kalendes per the homepage) and texts every online-booked client a few hours after the appointment. The SMS links to a branded mini page with a team video and pushes the client to leave a Google review rather than a Planity one. It also drafts replies to reviews (company-stated). The TrustMRR description promises salons on Planity 20–40 Google reviews a month and a top-3 Maps ranking without ads (founder-stated). €67 Solo / €97 Pro / Enterprise per month. Founded Feb 2025, FR. TrustMRR lists it as a stealth company, but the description names Coucou and the founder profile "Jean Gab" matches the founder named in Coucou's Trustpilot reviews. Linking the listing to getcoucou.io is my identification.

mentions.evidence: ~$5,912 MRR (+14.0% L30), 50 active subscriptions, ~$6,043 L30 (+25.7%), ~$39,070 last 12 months, ~$42,129 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 8, 2026 ~10:07 Warsaw (08:07 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Booksy is Polish-founded and widely used by PL salons and barbers. A Polish-language "Booksy → SMS → Google review" tool is the same product in your home market, priced per salon (SMSAPI/SerwerSMS make sending cheap). Coucou already claims Booksy compatibility, but not in Polish and not for the PL market.

whyItPrints: It's glue between a booking platform and Google Maps. Salons live and die by local search, and the booking platform's own review requests keep the reviews on the platform. 50 subs at ~$118/mo average (my calculation), with MRR up 14% in L30.
